consent.title: Cookies and traffic measurement
consent.text: We use Google Analytics to see which parts of this site help you. It only switches on once you agree. The WE Invoice app itself has no analytics at all.

thanks.title: Thanks, you're on the list
thanks.description: Your e-mail is confirmed. When we open the next wave of the e-invoicing beta, we'll send you an invitation code.
thanks.lead: Your e-mail is confirmed. When we open the next wave of the e-invoicing beta, you'll get an invitation code. Enter it in the app under Settings, E-invoicing, Invitation code.
thanks.meanwhile: No need to wait in the meantime: invoicing, expenses and bookkeeping work today. No sign-up, free.
thanks.unsubscribe: Changed your mind? Every e-mail we send has an unsubscribe link. We'll take you off the list straight away.

unsubscribed.title: You have unsubscribed
unsubscribed.description: We have removed your e-mail from the e-invoicing beta waiting list.
unsubscribed.lead: We have deleted your e-mail and everything you sent with the sign-up from the waiting list. You won't get any more e-mails from us.
unsubscribed.meanwhile: The app stays yours to use: invoicing, expenses and bookkeeping work without sign-up and for free.
